name: KUNG 攻 MACH 马赫 aero complete bike (105 R7120 / 105 Di2 R7170)
why_interesting: KUNG's JD flagship store sells the aero MACH as complete bikes with mechanical 105 R7120 or 105 Di2 R7170; a builder reports two such builds just under 8 kg.

facts.frame_material: Carbon MACH aero frame and fork (same platform as the published frameset)
facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical or 105 Di2 R7170 electronic 2×12 with hydraulic disc brakes (JD flagship titles)
facts.complete_weight: A builder reports a size-L R7170 build and a size-XS R7120 build each just under 8 kg; wheels, pedals and package contents not stated
facts.stiffness_evidence: Retailer ride review reports very direct power transfer; one owner comment reports fork flex with rotor rub when sprinting. No measured test
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Export-retailer MACH frame specification: up to 32 mm road tires; the JD complete-bike packages do not state their fitted tire

alternative_builds.label: MACH 7120 全碳整车
alternative_builds.drivetrain: Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2×12 with hydraulic disc brakes
alternative_builds.notes: JD flagship listing title; price hidden behind login on 24 October 2026.

alternative_builds.label: MACH 7170 全碳整车
alternative_builds.drivetrain: Shimano 105 Di2 R7170 electronic 2×12 with hydraulic disc brakes
alternative_builds.notes: JD flagship listing title; price hidden behind login on 24 October 2026.

missing: Dated mainland price for each complete build
Factory wheel, tire, cockpit and saddle specification for each JD package
Package weight with size and pedal basis
catalog_distinct_reason: Tracks KUNG's complete-bike packages alongside the published frameset-only record; the frameset's export price does not apply to these builds.
source_note: JD flagship titles identify the MACH complete-bike drivetrains. A builder's post (30 September 2026) reports a silver size-L R7170 build and a black-gold size-XS R7120 build each just under 8 kg; these were custom-assembled builds, so the weights are community reports rather than package specifications.
